workflow.title: Shipping FAQ replies and single Mike email (urgent + daily digest)
workflow.goal: For open tickets whose subject or body mentions 'shipping', send the shipping FAQ answer to the customer. Send Mike exactly one email per run containing the urgent open tickets and the daily digest of all other open tickets.

assumptions: Only tickets with status 'open' are handled.
'Mentions shipping' means the word appears in the subject or body, ignoring case.
The single email to Mike has an urgent section first, then a digest section listing every open non-urgent ticket, including shipping tickets that were auto-answered.
Each run sends exactly one email to mike@fitzone.com.
risks: Customers receive an automatic reply from the outbox for every shipping ticket, so a false keyword match sends an unneeded reply.
Mike receives one email on every run, including runs with no open tickets.
Urgent tickets are delivered with the scheduled run rather than immediately.
If the audit fails after sends, some emails may already have been delivered and cannot be recalled.
successCriteria: Every open shipping ticket has one FAQ reply sent to its customer address.
Exactly one email to mike@fitzone.com per run contains the urgent tickets and the daily digest of all other open tickets.
The outbox audit confirms the recipients and message hashes match this run.
